name: T币
source: 任务奖励、战斗掉落、世界探索
sourceEn: Quest rewards, battle drops, world exploration
description: 塔洛斯-II上通用的标准化货币，可用于购买各类物资和装备。
descriptionEn: Standardized currency used across Talos-II for purchasing supplies and equipment.

name: 武器检查官
description: 基础的武器升级材料，用于低级武器的强化和突破。
descriptionEn: Basic weapon upgrade material used for enhancing and ascending lower-rarity weapons.

name: 武器检查套件
description: 进阶武器升级套件，用于中级武器的强化和突破。
descriptionEn: Advanced weapon upgrade kit used for enhancing and ascending mid-rarity weapons.

name: 武器检查套装
description: 高级武器升级套装，用于高星级武器的强化和突破。
descriptionEn: Premium weapon upgrade set used for enhancing and ascending high-rarity weapons.

name: 源石碎片
description: 从源石矿脉中提取的碎片，含有微量的源石能量。用于低级角色晋升。
descriptionEn: Fragments extracted from Originium veins containing trace amounts of Originium energy. Used for lower-tier operator ascension.

name: 源石结晶
description: 经过自然结晶的源石，蕴含更纯净的能量。用于中级角色晋升。
descriptionEn: Naturally crystallized Originium containing purer energy. Used for mid-tier operator ascension.

name: 源石簇
description: 多个源石结晶聚合形成的簇状体，能量密度极高。用于高级角色晋升。
descriptionEn: Clusters formed by multiple Originium crystals with extremely high energy density. Used for high-tier operator ascension.

name: 源石浓缩液
description: 高度提纯的源石浓缩液，蕴含最为纯净和强大的源石能量。用于顶级角色晋升。
descriptionEn: Highly purified Originium concentrate containing the purest and most powerful Originium energy. Used for top-tier operator ascension.

name: 聚合凝胶
description: 经过聚合处理的凝胶材料，用于低级技能升级。
descriptionEn: Polymerized gel material used for lower-tier skill upgrades.

name: 聚合制备
description: 高纯度聚合制备物，用于中高级技能升级。
descriptionEn: High-purity polymerized preparation used for mid-to-high tier skill upgrades.

name: 研磨石
description: 用于磨砺刀剑的研磨石，剑类武器升级的常用材料。
descriptionEn: Grindstone used for sharpening blades, a common material for sword-type weapon upgrades.

name: 锰矿石
description: 坚硬的锰矿石，用于大剑类武器的锻造和升级。
descriptionEn: Hard manganese ore used for forging and upgrading great sword-type weapons.

name: 炽热合金
description: 高温锻造的特殊合金，用于高级武器的强化升级。
descriptionEn: Special alloy forged at high temperatures, used for high-tier weapon enhancement.

name: 晶体元件
description: 精密的晶体元件，用于铳类武器的维修和升级。
descriptionEn: Precision crystalline component used for handcannon-type weapon maintenance and upgrades.

name: 规约化武器图纸
description: 通过协议网络标准化的武器设计图纸，可用于制造高级武器。
descriptionEn: Weapon blueprint standardized through the Protocol Network, used for crafting high-tier weapons.
